config.oreexcavationfly.title: Create: Ore Excavation Fly
jei.oreexcavationfly.ore_header: Can be drilled with the Ore Drill from:
jei.oreexcavationfly.vein_line: %s: one item every %s s at 32 RPM
jei.oreexcavationfly.drill_info: Place on the chunk of an ore vein with the shaft end (back) towards the power source. The front face is the output: put a chest, vault, barrel or belt there. Twice the speed means twice the ore. Find veins with the Ore Vein Finder.
jei.oreexcavationfly.finder_info: Hold it to see the radar in the top-left corner; right-click prints the nearest vein in the action bar. It burns coal or charcoal from your inventory while held (one coal lasts 4 minutes by default). Every light green dot is a possible vein: blurred and roughly placed when far, sharp when close. The inner rings mark where the vein type and then the exact chunk are revealed. Stand in the vein's chunk and place an Ore Drill.
message.oreexcavationfly.finder.no_fuel: No coal: put coal or charcoal in your inventory
jei.oreexcavationfly.finder_tiers: Tiers: Iron sees 16 chunks and flickers often. Gold sees 1.5 times as far, aims better and flickers rarely. Diamond sees twice as far, aims best and never flickers. Upgrade on the smithing table: redstone + finder + gold block or diamond block. The coal inside carries over.
